phases.name: NKF
criteria: Pin reference gem/API and upstream source/tests, license/provenance and scope before implementation
Cover character conversion, MIME, guessing, public constants/options, binary/error/state-isolation semantics against reference
Define and verify native and Wasm behavior, resource/thread/state ownership
Turn unchanged commit-email upstream tool witness into a match, remeasure same fixed gems and HTTPS
Full appropriate regression/hosted gates, documentation, review and merge

scope: require nkf and nkf.so aliases with idempotent loading
two singleton and two private instance module functions
all constants and exact Encoding identity/nil values
to_str coercion, arity, NUL options, error precedence, frozen/subclass result semantics
all upstream conversion flags and charset aliases including CP932/JIS X0213/UTF16/32/BOM
MIME B/Q decode/encode/folding, default behavior and no conversion
kana width, normalization, newline, fold, ROT13/47, URL/CAP/numchar, fallback/filter flags
guess empty/ASCII/binary/invalid/ambiguous encodings and state reset after errors
Kconv plus String extensions only on require kconv
native and shipped browser Wasm use same pinned conversion engine
bounded allocation, native thread/embedding isolation, sanitizer and state stress
unchanged commit-email tool witness, fixed29gem inventory and HTTPS controls
architecture_research: Reuse pinned upstream portable C conversion tables/core; retain original licenses and provenance
Ruby wrapper ABI adaptation required; never invoke host Ruby, external nkf binary or subprocess conversion
Existing native byte FFI and embedding link/bundle lists must include glue
Current Apple clang supports wasm32, but wasm-ld/WASI sysroot/emcc absent; reproducible Wasm toolchain must be selected and pinned
Wasm side module, if used, must be instantiated by actual page and lifted smoke host with proper memory ownership and errors

isolated_engine_probe.coverage: Output bytes and no-output-encoding rejection only; not a Ruby VM/API integration pass

core_reference.note: Core CLI baseline only. Ruby deliberately suppresses output BOMs and has distinct no-option/guess APIs; do not label CLI results as Ruby API coverage.

research.native_state_isolation: Verified tools/native_probe/embedding_api.mere andEMBEDDING.md: experimental API is explicitly a singleton on one serialized host thread and refuses reentry. Multiple interleaved VMs are not supported by the current contract. Native NKF may use process-owned engine state under a mutex for each native phase, with no mutex across Ruby coercions, preserving nested conversion semantics; browser runs require fresh engine instance perVM. Cleanup must run after at_exit/scheduler teardown. Do not claim a multiVM native context implementation.

constraints: Keep original test workloads, assertion counts and resource limits
Do not mark skipped/zero/incomplete/limited measurements as successful compatibility tests
Use isolated worktrees and non-force pushes; preserve concurrent work
Keep existing private sidekiq-pro source-unavailable exclusion explicit
